card.name: Premature Burial
card.officialText: Activate this card by paying 800 LP, then target 1 monster in your GY; Special Summon it in Attack Position and equip it with this card. When this card is destroyed, destroy the equipped monster.

behavior.activation: Active physical representative Main Phase only; pays 800 LP immediately and moves Equip Spell from hand to face-up backrow.
behavior.targeting: One activation-time monster target from own team's shared Graveyard, bound by TargetBinding zone+epoch.
behavior.resolution: If target/source is no longer valid or Monster Zone fills, no summon; Equip Spell goes to GY if still present; 800 LP cost is never refunded.
behavior.summon: Special Summon face-up Attack Position; Equip Spell backrow.equippedTo links by physical UID.
behavior.destruction: Destroying Premature Burial destroys the equipped monster wherever control moved. Leaving field without destruction removes the link but does not destroy the monster. If monster leaves field, Equip Spell is sent to GY by equip rule.
behavior.ownership: UID preserves physical owner of spell and monster, including inactive partner; controller team is tracked separately.
behavior.idempotency: JSON-persisted activationId and equipped link; replay blocked.

certification.reason: Adapter-only preparation; card absent from shared cardCatalog/cardMetadata/cardCertifications. Resolver and catalog registration await M61 handoff.

limitations: Adapter não integrado ao resolver v9; Premature Burial não está certificada nem utilizável em decks.
Testes offline com TagDuel temporário; sem gateway/guild Discord real.
O adapter modela o pagamento de 800 LP e os efeitos de equip, mas não finaliza o duelo quando LP chega a zero; essa transição permanece responsabilidade do engine central.
Não altera resolver, metadata, certificações, manifesto, allowlist ou banco persistente.
